annotations.title: Gear ratio after a tire change, regear

description: Use for "what does my 3.73 axle behave like on 35s", "what ratio do I need to regear for 33s", RPM at highway speed after a tire change, or the crawl ratio (with transfer-case low ratio and first gear). Returns the effective ratio, RPM before and after in a 1:1 gear, the ratio that restores stock feel, the nearest gear set actually sold and how serious the change is.

new_tire.description: New tire. Metric like 265/70R17 (P or LT prefix allowed) or flotation like 33x12.50R17; no load index or speed rating.

old_tire.description: Factory tire. Metric like 265/70R17 (P or LT prefix allowed) or flotation like 33x12.50R17; no load index or speed rating.

speed_mph.description: Road speed for the RPM figures (default 65).

name: gear_ratio_calculator
